title: UCP transport bindings
caption: The same capability runs over four transports. Each service entry in a profile pairs a transport with an endpoint and a machine-readable description. The platform names its profile in a header on REST and A2A, and in a meta object on MCP.
alt: Flowchart. One operation, create checkout, maps to four transports. REST uses POST /checkout-sessions with UCP-Agent, Idempotency-Key and Request-Id headers and is described by OpenAPI 3.1. MCP uses tools/call create_checkout with meta ucp-agent profile in the arguments and is described by OpenRPC over streamable HTTP. A2A sends a message with a DataPart keyed a2a.ucp.checkout, with UCP-Agent and X-A2A-Extensions headers, described by an Agent Card at the endpoint. Embedded uses ec.* JSON-RPC messages such as ec.ready, ec.start, ec.complete and ec.payment.credential_request inside a host frame, described by OpenRPC.
